主要内容: Royal Bank of Canada appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as its auditor. Shareholders voted overwhelmingly in favor of the appointment, with 99.70% of votes cast in favor. The vote for the auditor received 781,644,227 votes in favor and 2,371,293 votes withheld. Other shareholder votes included advisory votes on executive compensation, amendments to by-laws regarding board compensation, and proposals on financial reporting simplification.
